name: io.github.mguozhen/voc-amazon-reviews-mcp
title: VOC Amazon Reviews
description:
Agent-native Amazon review intelligence. Pulls reviews from 10 marketplaces via Shulex OpenAPI (not 
scrapers), tagged with verified-purchase + Vine + helpful-vote signals. Produces copy-ready listing improvements.

environmentVariables.name: VOC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description:
Shulex VOC OpenAPI key. Free tier: 100 calls/month, no credit card. Get one at 
https://apps.voc.ai/openapi

environmentVariables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Anthropic API key. Only needed for extract_listing_improvements.
